traits.label: Hymenium
traits.text: Gills that are crowded, adnexed to almost free; initially pale then becoming brownish as the spores mature.
traits.raw: ℹ️ Hymenium: Gills that are crowded, adnexed to almost free; initially pale then becoming brownish as the spores mature.

traits.label: Cap
traits.text: Conical to bell-shaped, often with a small umbo; smooth or with tiny fibrous scales; white or pale lilac in variety lilacina.
traits.raw: ℹ️ Cap: Conical to bell-shaped, often with a small umbo; smooth or with tiny fibrous scales; white or pale lilac in variety lilacina.

traits.label: Hymenium attachment
traits.text: Adnexed to almost free.
traits.raw: ℹ️ Hymenium attachment: Adnexed to almost free.

traits.label: Stipe
traits.text: Slender, cylindrical, and often swollen at the base; fibrous, white or slightly lilac in variety lilacina, with a bulbous base.
traits.raw: ℹ️ Stipe: Slender, cylindrical, and often swollen at the base; fibrous, white or slightly lilac in variety lilacina, with a bulbous base.

traits.label: Description
traits.text: Brown.
traits.raw: 🟤 Brown.

traits.label: Ecology
traits.text: Mycorrhizal with broad-leaved trees, especially in grassy areas and parks.
traits.raw: 🪵 Mycorrhizal with broad-leaved trees, especially in grassy areas and parks.

traits.label: Odour
traits.text: Mild, sometimes with a slightly mealy scent.
traits.raw: 👃 Mild, sometimes with a slightly mealy scent.

traits.label: Edibility
traits.text: Toxic; contains muscarine which can cause serious poisoning.
traits.raw: ⚠️☠️ Toxic; contains muscarine which can cause serious poisoning.

traits.label: Fruit body
traits.text: Cap diameter of 1.5-4 cm; stipe length of 4-6 cm.
traits.raw: 📏 Cap diameter of 1.5-4 cm; stipe length of 4-6 cm.

traits.label: Overview
traits.text: Small, delicate mushroom recognized by its pale colors and distinctive conical cap. The variety lilacina exhibits lilac hues on its cap and stipe.
traits.raw: 🔤 Small, delicate mushroom recognized by its pale colors and distinctive conical cap. The variety lilacina exhibits lilac hues on its cap and stipe.

traits.label: Microscopy
traits.text: Spores are almond-shaped, 7-9 x 4-5 µm, smooth, and brown in mass.
traits.raw: 🔬 Spores are almond-shaped, 7-9 x 4-5 µm, smooth, and brown in mass.
